statements.english: Well thank God you were here ! I mean , we have to erase that !
statements.chinese: 谢天谢地你在这儿！我是说，我们得把那个删掉！

statements.english: What ?! We can't do that !
statements.chinese: 什么？！我们不能那么做！

statements.english: We have too ! I mean what if Ross's hears that
statements.chinese: 我们也有！我是说，要是让Ross听到怎么办

statements.english: and then calls her back and then they get back together ?
statements.chinese: 然后他又把她叫回来，接着他们就复合了？

calls.definition: call（第三人称单数）: 打电话

statements.english: Is that what you want ?
statements.chinese: 这就是你想要的吗？

statements.english: Ross back with that controlling
statements.chinese: Ross又带着那控制欲回来了,

statements.english: neurotic , crazy Emily ?
statements.chinese: 神经质又疯狂的Emily？

statements.english: The Emily that wouldn't let him see you ?
statements.chinese: 那个不让他见你的Emily吗？

statements.english: Noo ! Oh no ! No ! God no !
statements.chinese: 不！哦不！不要！天啊不要！

statements.english: He should not get back together with her
statements.chinese: 他不应该和她复合。

statements.english: I know that ! You know that ! Even Ross knows that !
statements.chinese: 我知道！你知道！就连Ross都知道！

knows.definition: know（第三人称单数）: 知道

statements.english: But that still doesn't give us the right to erase his message !
statements.chinese: 但这仍然不能成为我们抹去他留言的理由！

statements.english: I'm his sister , okay ? I love him !
statements.chinese: 我是他妹妹，懂吗？我爱他！

statements.english: I don't want to see him get hurt !
statements.chinese: 我不想看到他受伤！

statements.english: Come on ! Doesn't that give me the right to control himhelp him ?
statements.chinese: 拜托！这难道不给我权利去管束他、帮助他吗？

Doesn't.definition: do（第三人称单数现在时否定式）: 不

statements.english: I don't think he's the one who needs help
statements.chinese: 我认为需要帮助的人不是他。

needs.definition: need（第三人称单数）: 需要

statements.english: No , look , she's obviously unstable , okay ?
statements.chinese: 不，你看，她显然情绪不稳定，明白吗？

statements.english: I mean she's thinking about running out on her wedding day
statements.chinese: 我是说她在考虑婚礼当天逃婚。

statements.english: Okay , fine ! But I mean , look at the position she's putting him in !
statements.chinese: 好吧，行！但我是说，看看她把他置于什么境地了！

statements.english: What's he gonna do ?
statements.chinese: 他打算怎么做？

statements.english: Ross is gonna run over there on the wedding day
statements.chinese: Ross打算在婚礼当天跑过去

statements.english: and break up the marriage ?! I mean , who would do that ?!
statements.chinese: 还要拆散婚姻？！我是说，谁会干这种事啊？！

would.definition: would（过去式）: 构成过去将来时

statements.english: Okay , fine , all right , but that's y'know , it's different !
statements.chinese: 好吧，行，可以，但你知道的，这不一样！

statements.english: Although it did involve a lot of the same people
statements.chinese: 尽管其中确实牵涉到许多相同的人。

did.definition: do（过去式）: 构成疑问或强调

statements.english: Y'know what , this is obviously some kind of twisted joke
statements.chinese: 你知道吗，这显然是个扭曲的玩笑

is.definition: be（现在时第三人称单数）: 是

statements.english: she's trying to play on him
statements.chinese: 她试图玩弄他。

statements.english: Okay , you are crazy !
statements.chinese: 好吧，你真是疯了！

statements.english: I'm sorry , but she sounded generally upset ! I mean , listen !
statements.chinese: 很抱歉，但她听起来确实很不高兴！我是说，你听听！

statements.english: Your messages have been erased
statements.chinese: 您的消息已被删除。

been.definition: be（过去分词）: 构成现在完成时

statements.english: Noooooooo !

Noooooooo.definition: 表示强烈的情感（如惊讶、失望等）

statements.english: Okay , y'know , we-we're safe right ?
statements.chinese: 好吧，你知道的，我们-我们现在安全了吧？

statements.english: I mean nothing bad can go down !
statements.chinese: 我是说，坏事不可能发生！

statements.english: No . But that reminds me , sign this
statements.chinese: 不。不过这倒提醒我了，把这个签了。

reminds.definition: remind（第三人称单数）: 提醒

statements.english: What is it ?
statements.chinese: 这是什么？

statements.english: Oh it's nothing , it just says that you can't sue the city
statements.chinese: 哦，没什么，只是说你不能起诉市政府

statements.english: if you scrap your knee or y'know , get your head blown off
statements.chinese: 如果你擦伤了膝盖，或者，你知道的，脑袋被轰掉。

statements.english: Oh , hurry up . I want to sign that
statements.chinese: 哦，快点。我想签那个。

statements.english: Okay , here he comes
statements.chinese: 好的，他来了。

statements.english: What is he doing ? What the hell is he doing ?!
statements.chinese: 他在干什么？他到底在搞什么鬼？！

statements.english: What ? What ? What ? What is it ?
statements.chinese: 什么？什么？什么？这是什么？

statements.english: Is everything okay ?
statements.chinese: 一切都还好吗？

statements.english: What's going on ?
statements.chinese: 发生什么事了？

statements.english: Okay , he sees us . Now don't move . Don't look at him
statements.chinese: 好了，他看到我们了。现在别动，也别看他。

sees.definition: see（第三人称单数）: 看见

statements.english: Hey , it's okay . It was just a car backfire
statements.chinese: 嘿，没事的。那只是汽车回火的声音。

statements.english: Hey , look at that ! You tried to save your buddy
statements.chinese: 嘿，快看！你想救你的哥们儿来着。

statements.english: You see that ? You see what he did ?
statements.chinese: 你看见了吗？你看见他刚才做了什么吗？

statements.english: You okay man ?
statements.chinese: 你还好吗，老兄？

statements.english: Thank Joey !
statements.chinese: 谢谢Joey！

statements.english: Uh , Hello !!
statements.chinese: 呃，你好！！

statements.english: Hi
statements.chinese: 你好。

statements.english: All right , I guess we should go
statements.chinese: 好吧，我想我们该走了。
